args.description: shoves the invisible opponent she is holding forward with her free hand, then slashes straight ahead with a broad black and red sword, larger and more jagged, with red ribbons, then returns to the ready stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame. The whole weapon stays inside the picture. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves her), always facing right, seen from the side; keep her look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what she holds: no glow, no flash, no sparks, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground; the whole body, the weapon and any trail stay inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young woman with a long black and red ponytail and red eyes, a closed black and red top covering the stomach, wide black and red sleeves, long black shorts over opaque black tights, black and red boots, holding a broad black and red sword, larger and more jagged, with red ribbons
args.initial_pose: holding an invisible opponent in front of her with both hands
